notes.title: New "looks and loc" update released!
notes.content:
Hello diving fans! We are excited to share that we released a game update that includes a major graphics refresh (e.g. more realistic underwater lighting) as well as Spanish localization and bug fixes for the French, German, and Hungarian localizations. 

We are currently working on a set of gameplay improvements suggested by our players, so please let us know if you have any feedback for us. You can either post your suggestions on our Steam discussion hub or send mail to customerservice@infinitescuba.com.

Thanks so much for your help and patience!
    The Infinite Scuba team at Cascade Game Foundry SPC

ps: The SPC in our name stands for 'social purpose corporation', the Washington state version of a 'B' corporation. Our social goals are environmental education and the promotion of STEM skills. We donate $1 of each 'Infinite Scuba' game purchased to ocean awareness non-profit organizations like Mission Blue (Dr. Sylvia Earle's group), and we provide 'Infinite Scuba' free to teachers and schools. All proceeds from 'Dive with Sylvia VR' go to Mission Blue.

notes.title: Infinite Scuba VR is at Earth Day TX this weekend!
notes.content:
Hi! We are showing our VR and conventional game with our awesome environmental partner Mission Blue at Earth Day TX in Dallas this weekend. Drop by Centennial Hall Booth 5315 to:
* Do a virtual dive with Dr. Sylvia Earle
* Check out our latest (pre-release) divesite
* Get free tickets to the EarthX film "A Plastic Ocean"
* Learn more about what you can do to protect the ocean
* Talk to some of the people who create Infinite Scuba

Thanks & Happy Earth Day!
   Kathie Flood, Cascade Game Foundry SPC, Managing Director & CEO
